Second, I'm curious about the time difference between 'New York, NY' and 'Los Angeles, CA'. Third, I've been trying to keep track of my health and I'd like to calculate my Body Mass Index (BMI). I weigh '75' kilograms and I'm '180' centimeters tall, and I'd like to use the 'metric' system. Lastly, I've written a piece of text in 'English' and I'd like to perform a sentiment analysis on it. The text is 'I had a wonderful day at the beach. The weather was perfect and I enjoyed a delicious ice cream.' Can you assist me with these?"

system.description: The system of units to be used, 'metric' or 'imperial'. Default is 'metric'.

function.name: hotel_booking
function.description: Books a hotel room for a specific date range. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. New York, NY.

start_date.description: The start date of the reservation. Use format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date of the reservation. Use format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

rooms.description: The number of rooms to reserve.

function.name: sentiment_analysis
function.description: Perform sentiment analysis on a given piece of text. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

text.description: The text on which to perform sentiment analysis.

language.description: The language in which the text is written.

function.name: get_time_difference
function.description: Get the time difference between two places. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

place1.description: The first place for time difference.

place2.description: The second place for time difference.
